intro: Kotor's protected tree stands inside the walled Old Town. A black poplar in Trg od Kina, the small square of a former Franciscan monastery, was declared a natural monument by the municipal assembly in March 2021. The study behind that decision assumes it was planted around 1667, after the great earthquake, which would make it roughly 350 years old, past the 300 years the same study gives as the species' usual span. Its trunk is 5.10 metres round.
meta_description: Kotor's black poplar in Trg od Kina, Old Town: a natural monument since 2021, put at roughly 350 years, free to see in the square.
question_meta: Kotor's oldest protected tree is the black poplar of Trg od Kina in the Old Town, assumed planted around 1667.
question_answer: The oldest protected tree in Kotor is the black poplar in Trg od Kina, Cinema Square, inside the walled Old Town. The study that got it declared a natural monument in 2021 assumes it was planted around 1667, after the great earthquake, so roughly 350 years is a broad figure.
question_context: The poplar grew up in the courtyard of the Franciscan monastery of Our Lady of the Angels. The planting date of about 1667 is the protection study's assumption, tied to the rebuilding after the earthquake that struck Kotor that year, and not a written record. The monastery church was rebuilt in 1722, and in the 1950s the complex became the Boka cinema, which is why the square is still called Trg od Kina. The buildings now hold the City Gallery and the library. The same study says black poplars live to about 300 years, which puts this one past the usual span. Its trunk measures 5.10 metres round and 1.62 metres across, it rises 17 metres, and its crown spreads just over 14 metres, lopsided because dry branches have been cut away over the years. The Kotor municipal assembly declared it a natural monument in March 2021. The Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage site, and the square is open and free, a few minutes on foot from the Sea Gate and the main bus station.

trees.story:
Black poplars live to about 300 years, according to the study that got this one protected, and this one is past it. In March 2021 the municipal assembly of Kotor declared it a natural monument, a single poplar in a small square inside the walled Old Town.

The study assumes it was planted around 1667, after the great earthquake that struck Kotor, in the courtyard of the Franciscan monastery of Our Lady of the Angels. That date is the study's assumption, not a written record, so take roughly 350 years as a broad figure. The monastery church was rebuilt in 1722. In the 1950s the complex became the Boka cinema. The square is still called Trg od Kina, Cinema Square, and the buildings now hold the City Gallery and the library.

The poplar has stood through all of it. Its trunk is 5.10 metres round and 1.62 metres across, it rises 17 metres, and its crown spreads just over 14 metres. The crown is lopsided, because dry branches have been cut away over the years.

The Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage site and the square is open and free. It is a few minutes on foot from the Sea Gate and the main bus station.

trees.verify_notes: Legally protected natural monument (III category, regime of protection II, parcel 341 K.O. Kotor II, crown projection 154 m2). Measurements are from the decision and the protection study prepared for it (Agency-prepared study, 2020 valorisation): girth 510 cm (diameter 162 cm), height 17 m, crown span 14.20 m, crown asymmetric from pruning of dry branches. Age: study says it is assumed to have been planted around 1667, after the great earthquake that hit Kotor, in the courtyard of the former Franciscan monastery of Our Lady of the Angels (Gospe od Andela); the church was rebuilt 1722, the complex became the cinema 'Boka' in the 1950s, now City Gallery and library. The age rests on an assumption in the study, not a dated record: broad range, about 350 years. The study says black poplars live up to about 300 years, this one over 300. Official coordinate N 42 25 30.4163 E 18 46 13.4314 (central point of the monument) = 42.42511, 18.77038. Alive: decision 2021; iNaturalist observation 2026-05-09 by lifecheck.py (RECENT). Plane trees: search found no protected plane in Kotor Old Town; this poplar is the tree. The tree's proposal draft on kotor.me was titled PRIJEDLOG; the adopted decision (18.6 pdf) dated 31.03.2021 was fetched and read. Pin is the official crown-centre coordinate of a single tree on a small square, so confirmed.
